reviewFlags.text: The ODT quotes Romans 8:31 in ESV; the proposed worksheet activities use the full BSB wording, which differs at “in response to these things.” Confirm the passage and Scripture distribution clearance.
Approve the twelve newly suggested wrong Multiple Choice choices. Each question has one correct and two believable wrong answers.
Approve the seven suggested false statements. Confirm that the false statements are clearly wrong and age-appropriate.
Check four plausible unrelated Bible-era words: ALTAR, HARP, VINEYARD and TOWER. None belongs to this lesson.
Check four different incorrect Checkboxes words: Trumpet, Temple, Grapes and Chariot.
Review the six intentional errors and corrections. The source includes an Egyptian killed by Moses; the activity avoids depicting the death.
Review the simplified story order, Finish the Story paragraph, and Large Draw the Story captions for fidelity to the original theology and chronology.
The source states that Moses killed an Egyptian and Pharaoh tried to kill Moses. Review age-appropriate wording and whether this should appear in child-facing activities.
Four Small drawing choices focus on the bush, the sandals, the staff becoming a snake, and the journey back to Egypt. Confirm suitability and variety.
The 27 modules have prepared content, but real puzzle generators and all three numbered presets have not been run here. Verify preflight and printing before approval.
